prompt:
An 8-frame looping walk cycle of this chibi character, side view facing right, cute light bouncy steps. Keep the exact same anime cel-shaded art style, face, hat, red scarf, cream coat, backpack and colours as the SECOND image in every frame.

画法：日系二次元动漫插画，线条干净，赛璐璐上色加柔和的光影过渡，不做成 3D。萌系、温馨治愈的手机游戏美术。Q 版小人：大头、两三头身，五官可爱，表情温柔开心。

The FIRST attached image is a pose guide sheet: 8 frames in 4 columns x 2 rows of equal cells, read left to right, top to bottom. Each cell shows a simple big-headed chibi mannequin (about 2.5 heads tall) in one pose of the animation. ORANGE limbs are the character's near (camera-side) arm and leg; BLUE limbs are the far arm and leg, behind the body; the gray shapes are the head and torso; the small dark wedge on the head shows the facing direction (right). Draw EXACTLY the character from the SECOND attached image in each of these 8 poses, in the same cell, at the same position and size, matching every limb angle, every joint bend and the head position of the mannequin. The mannequin is only a guide and must not be visible in the result. The character must look identical in every frame: same face, hair, clothes, colours, outlines and proportions.

Fully transparent background. No grid lines, cell borders, frame numbers, labels, text, ground or shadows.

不要文字，不要水印，不要标志。设计全部原创，不要模仿任何现有作品里的角色、火车或场景。
